identity_grounding.note: Each identity edit names visible facial, hair, and facial-hair traits; the paired target video remains the pixel-level target. Internal identity IDs must never appear in model-facing text.

description_policy.hair_policy: Hair and facial hair are part of the current identity presentation and change with an E1 identity edit.

prompt_target.zh-CN: 一位浅暖肤色、鼻梁和双颊带淡雀斑的成年女性，脸型修长偏椭圆，眼睛呈深灰绿色，鼻梁细长，嘴唇饱满，留浅灰棕色长发、厚齐刘海和双高发髻
prompt_target.en: an adult woman with light warm skin, faint freckles across her nose and cheeks, a long oval face, dark gray-green eyes, a slim long nose, full lips, and long ash-brown hair with blunt bangs and two high buns

full_description.zh-CN: 她具有修长的椭圆脸和柔和收窄的下颌，浅暖肤色上可见鼻梁与双颊雀斑。眼睛较大、略显下垂，呈深灰绿色，并伴有轻微眼下阴影；鼻梁细长、鼻尖圆润，双唇宽而饱满。浅灰棕色长发配厚齐刘海、双高发髻和两侧垂发，是最醒目的身份特征。
full_description.en: She has a long oval face with a softly tapered jaw and light warm skin with freckles across the nose and cheeks. Her relatively large, slightly downturned dark gray-green eyes have mild under-eye shadows; the nose is slim and long with a rounded tip, and the lips are broad and full. Long ash-brown hair with blunt bangs, two high buns, and long side lengths is her strongest visual identifier.

prompt_target.zh-CN: 一位浅暖肤色的成年女性，脸型偏菱形、颧骨清晰且下巴收窄，眼睛狭长呈棕色，鼻梁直而窄，嘴唇中等，留深色侧分长发，一侧贴头、另一侧呈长波浪，嘴角旁有一颗小痣
prompt_target.en: an adult woman with light warm skin, a diamond-leaning face with defined cheekbones and a narrow chin, narrow brown eyes, a straight slim nose, medium lips, long dark side-parted hair swept close on one side and wavy on the other, and a small mole beside her mouth

full_description.zh-CN: 她的脸型偏菱形，颧骨清晰，下颌线向较窄的下巴收拢，肤色浅而偏暖。棕色眼睛狭长，眉毛较细且上扬；鼻梁直而窄，嘴唇厚度中等。深色长发采用深侧分，一侧紧贴头部，另一侧形成长波浪；嘴角旁的小痣提供了稳定辨识点。
full_description.en: She has a diamond-leaning face with defined cheekbones, a jaw that narrows toward the chin, and light warm skin. Her brown eyes are narrow, the eyebrows are slim and raised, the nose is straight and narrow, and the lips are medium in fullness. Long dark hair has a deep side part, swept close on one side and falling in long waves on the other; a small mole beside the mouth is a stable distinguishing mark.

prompt_target.zh-CN: 一位中等暖棕肤色的成年女性，脸型宽圆偏椭圆、双颊饱满，下颌较宽且下巴圆润，眼睛呈浅蓝灰色，鼻头较宽圆，嘴唇饱满，留黑色短波波头、短刘海和向外翻卷的发尾

full_description.zh-CN: 她具有宽圆偏椭圆的脸型、饱满双颊、较宽下颌和圆润下巴，中等暖棕肤色可见自然纹理和少量面颊斑点。浅蓝灰色眼睛呈杏仁形，眉毛浓密并明显上扬；鼻头宽圆，双唇饱满。黑色短波波头配短刘海和向外翻卷的发尾，使整体轮廓非常明确。
full_description.en: She has a broad rounded oval face with full cheeks, a wide jaw, and a rounded chin. Her medium warm-brown skin shows natural texture and a few cheek marks. Light blue-gray almond-shaped eyes sit beneath thick, strongly arched eyebrows; the nose has a broad rounded tip and the lips are full. A short black bob with short bangs and outward-curled ends gives her a distinct silhouette.

full_description.zh-CN: 她的脸型修长且骨骼轮廓清晰，颧骨较高，下颌向窄而略方的下巴收拢，肤色为中等暖褐色。浅灰蓝色眼睛较狭长并带明显眼下阴影；鼻梁高直、侧面突出，嘴唇轮廓清晰且上唇较薄。深棕色头发松散编成侧辫，额前留有碎发，颈前小痣是稳定辨识点。
full_description.en: She has a long, well-defined face with high cheekbones and a jaw that tapers toward a narrow, slightly squared chin, set against medium warm-brown skin. Her light gray-blue eyes are narrow with visible under-eye shadows; the nose has a high straight bridge and a projected profile, and the lips are clearly shaped with a thinner upper lip. Dark-brown hair is gathered into a loose side braid with wispy front strands, and a mole on the front of the neck is a stable identifier.
